shortDescription: Tanfeeth is a business process outsourcing and shared services company in Dubai, operating as a fully owned subsidiary of Emirates NBD Group.
whatTheyDo: Established in 2011, Tanfeeth manages back-office banking operations, customer contact centers, collections, and human resources processing across the UAE. It serves primarily as the shared services backbone for Emirates NBD and Emirates Islamic banks. Its teams handle customer care, fraud monitoring, and financial transaction processing.
address: Building Q, Meydan Business Park, Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as JLT, but headquarters is located at Building Q, Meydan Business Park, Nad Al Sheba 1. Formerly known as Tanfeeth LLC, the company was rebranded as Emirates NBD Global Services LLC, with recruitment integrated into Emirates NBD Group Careers.

shortDescription: Tensor is an engineering and infrastructure contractor in Dubai specializing in mission-critical data center facilities.
whatTheyDo: The company provides data center infrastructure solutions spanning MEP engineering, EPC execution, project management, and data center technical audits. In Dubai Silicon Oasis, it has delivered infrastructure for Gulf Data Hub, including work on the GDH-DSO-B5 and GDH-DSO-B3 data centers. Its technical teams execute electrical, mechanical, and SCADA infrastructure integrations.
notes: Input listed name as 'Tensor Systems', which confused it with an unrelated Zimbabwean infrastructure firm; the UAE entity operating in Dubai Silicon Oasis is Tensor (tensor.ae), a data center EPC specialist. Specific office building coordinates are not publicly listed.

shortDescription: The IML Group is a field and experiential marketing agency headquartered in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Founded in 1992, The IML Group provides brand activations, in-store promotions, merchandising, mystery shopping, and retail staffing across the Middle East and Africa. In the UAE, it manages promotional campaigns and outsourced brand ambassador teams for multinational consumer brands. Its Dubai office oversees regional marketing campaigns and field personnel deployment.
address: Office 105, Hilal Salim Bin Tarraf Building, Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Wasl, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as Downtown, but the head office is located in the Hilal Salim Bin Tarraf Building (commonly known as the Lufthansa Building) in Al Wasl on Sheikh Zayed Road, directly opposite the Business Bay Metro Station.

shortDescription: TIME Hotels is a UAE-based hospitality management company that operates hotels and serviced apartments.
whatTheyDo: Established in 2012, TIME Hotels manages a portfolio of hotels, extended-stay residences, and hotel apartments across the UAE and GCC. In Dubai, its properties include TIME Oak Hotel & Suites in Al Barsha and TIME Grand Plaza Hotel in Al Qusais. Its headquarters houses central management, corporate revenue, marketing, and hospitality operations teams.
address: Office 2203, 22nd Floor, Control Tower, Motor City, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as Business Bay, but corporate headquarters is at Office 2203, Control Tower in Motor City, Dubai. The company does not operate any hotel or corporate office in Business Bay.

shortDescription: Transguard Group is a major UAE business support and security services provider, operating as an associate of the Emirates Group.
whatTheyDo: Established in 2001, Transguard provides cash services, manned security, facilities management, aviation ground handling, and manpower solutions across the UAE. It supports large-scale infrastructure including Dubai International Airport and commercial properties. Its teams manage cash transit, surveillance systems, technical facilities maintenance, and airport ramp logistics.
address: Emirates Group Security Building, Dubai Airport Freezone (DAFZA), Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as JLT, but corporate headquarters is located at the Emirates Group Security Building in Dubai Airport Freezone (DAFZA).

shortDescription: Union Coop is the largest consumer cooperative and retail hypermarket chain in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Founded in 1982 and listed on the Dubai Financial Market, Union Coop operates commercial shopping malls, hypermarkets, and community supermarkets across Dubai. It manages retail grocery operations, fresh food production, private-label goods, and supply chain logistics. Its corporate teams oversee merchandising, inventory distribution, retail operations, and commercial leasing.
address: Al Warqa City Mall, Al Warqa 3, Tripoli Street, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as Dubai Internet City, but Union Coop headquarters is located at Al Warqa City Mall, Al Warqa 3, Tripoli Street, Dubai.

shortDescription: United Engineering Construction (UNEC) is a prominent UAE general contracting and civil engineering company.
whatTheyDo: Established in 1976, UNEC delivers turnkey general contracting, civil construction, and project management for commercial, residential, and infrastructure projects across the UAE. In Dubai, it has executed developments including The Address Residence Fountain Views near Burj Khalifa in Downtown Dubai and Silicon Central in Dubai Silicon Oasis. Its operations cover structural engineering, MEP coordination, and site supervision.
address: Karm Square, Arjan, Al Barsha South, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed name as 'United Engineering' in 'Downtown'. In the UAE, two prominent entities share this name fragment: United Engineering Construction (UNEC, headquartered at Karm Square in Arjan / Al Barsha South) and United Engineering & Contracting Co (UECC, located in Prism Tower, Business Bay). UNEC is the major contractor that constructed key Downtown Dubai projects including The Address Residence Fountain Views.

shortDescription: The University of Dubai is an accredited higher education institution established by the Dubai Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
whatTheyDo: Founded in 1997, the university offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs in business administration, law, and electrical engineering and information technology. Located on a dedicated campus in Dubai International Academic City, it conducts academic teaching, applied research, and executive education. It operates an Internship and Career Development Center (ICDC) to facilitate career placements.
address: Academic City, Emirates Road, Exit 49, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Wikidata Entry for University of Dubai

shortDescription: VFS Global is an international outsourcing and technology services specialist for governments and diplomatic missions, co-headquartered in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Founded in 2001, VFS Global manages administrative and non-judgmental visa, passport, and consular tasks for client governments worldwide. In Dubai, its corporate headquarters oversees regional operations, compliance, and technological rollouts. It also operates large-scale public visa application centers in the UAE, including its primary center at Wafi Mall.
address: Unit 3205-3209, Jumeirah Business Centre 1, Cluster G, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai, UAE
notes: Corporate headquarters in the UAE is located at JBC 1 in Cluster G, JLT, Dubai. The primary public-facing Visa Application Centre is situated at Wafi Mall, Umm Hurair 2.

shortDescription: Virgin Mobile Middle East & Africa (VMMEA) is a mobile virtual network operator headquartered in Dubai Internet City.
whatTheyDo: Headquartered in Dubai Internet City and acquired by Beyond ONE in 2023, VMMEA manages mobile virtual network operations across the Middle East and Africa. In the UAE, Virgin Mobile operates as a digital mobile brand in partnership with Emirates Integrated Telecommunications Company (EITC / du). Its regional teams manage digital mobile platforms, customer lifecycle marketing, and telecom operations.
notes: Input listed entity as 'Virgin MENA' in Dubai Internet City, which corresponds to the regional headquarters of Virgin Mobile Middle East & Africa (VMMEA, acquired by Beyond ONE in 2023). In the UAE consumer market, Virgin Mobile operates as a business unit within Emirates Integrated Telecommunications Company (du).
